name: com.motioncore.basic2d
description: A 2D platformer character controller for Unity 6. Horizontal movement with acceleration, deceleration, and air control; manual gravity with a fall multiplier and maximum fall speed; variable-height jumping that reaches the configured height exactly, with coyote time and jump buffering; crouching with a lowered collider and ceiling check; box-cast ground detection; and walkable-slope handling. Input from the Input System or from your own code, events and published state for animation and audio, custom inspectors with one-click fixes, debug gizmos, example scripts, and a self-contained demo scene. Mobile touch controls are not included.
